															BPSC DSO 2025: Eligibility Criteria

															
																A graduate degree from a recognized university.
																The candidate must have a Diploma in Sports Coaching from the Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (Sports Authority of India), or a Post Graduate Diploma in Sports Coaching (PGDCSD) from Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education, Gwalior, or a Central Sports University, or any other sports university recognized by the UGC or Bihar Sports University.
																
																Sports Achievements:
																
																
																The candidate should have represented their country in recognized competitions or represented the state in National/International Championships such as the Olympics, Commonwealth Games, or Asian Games.
																
																
																Alternatively, the candidate should have participated at least twice in the All India Inter University/Recognized Junior Championship/National Youth Championship or three times in the Inter-Services Competition/All India Police Games/Inter-Railway Championship.

🎓 Eligibility Criteria for BPSC DSO 2025

  A graduate degree from a recognized university.
  The candidate must have a Diploma in Sports Coaching from the Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (Sports Authority of India), or a Post Graduate Diploma in Sports Coaching (PGDCSD) from Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education, Gwalior, or a Central Sports University, or any other sports university recognized by the UGC or Bihar Sports University.
  Sports Achievements:
    
      The candidate should have represented their country in recognized competitions or represented the state in National/International Championships such as the Olympics, Commonwealth Games, or Asian Games.
      Alternatively, the candidate should have participated at least twice in the All India Inter University/Recognized Junior Championship/National Youth Championship or three times in the Inter-Services Competition/All India Police Games/Inter-Railway Championship.

																A graduate degree from a recognized university.

															📌 Selection Process

															The selection process will consist of three stages:

															1️⃣ Stage 1 – Hindi Language (Qualifying Paper)

															
																
																📝 The Hindi Language paper will be of 100 marks.
																
																
																✅ It is a qualifying paper only (marks will not be added to the merit list).
																
																
																Candidates must score the minimum qualifying marks as prescribed.
																
															

															2️⃣ Stage 2 – Written Examination

															
																
																The written exam will consist of two papers:
																
															

															📄 Paper I (100 Marks)

															
																
																Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)
																
																
																Duration: ⏰ 2 hours
																
																
																Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, and Subject Knowledge
																
															

															📄 Paper II (100 Marks)

															
																
																Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)
																
																
																Duration: ⏰ 2 hours
																
																
																Syllabus: Post Graduate level Subject Knowledge
																
															

															3️⃣ Stage 3 – Evaluation of Achievements

															
																
																🏅 Sports Achievements (Certificates of Olympic/World/Asian/Commonwealth/National/University level competitions)
																
																
																🎓 Professional Courses in Sports Coaching/Sports Science
																
															

															🏆 Marks Distribution for Sports Achievements

															
																
																Olympics / World Championship / Asian Games / Commonwealth Games

																
																	
																	🥇 Gold: 20 marks
																	
																	
																	🥈 Silver: 18 marks
																	
																	
																	🥉 Bronze: 16 marks
																	
																	
																	🎖 Participation: 15 marks
																	
																
																
																
																World Police Games / Afro-Asian Games / World University Games / Youth Olympic / SAFF Games

																
																	
																	🥇 Gold: 15 marks
																	
																	
																	🥈 Silver: 13 marks
																	
																	
																	🥉 Bronze: 11 marks
																	
																	
																	🎖 Participation: 10 marks
																	
																
																
																
																National Games / Senior National Championship

																
																	
																	🥇 Gold: 10 marks
																	
																	
																	🥈 Silver: 8 marks
																	
																	
																	🥉 Bronze: 7 marks
																	
																	
																	🎖 Participation: 5 marks
																	
																
																
																
																All India Inter-University / Police Games / Services Championship / Khelo India / SGFI Competitions

																
																	
																	🥇 Gold: 7 marks
																	
																	
																	🥈 Silver: 5 marks
																	
																	
																	🥉 Bronze: 3 marks
																	
																	
																	🎖 Participation: 2 marks
																	
																
																
															

															🎓 Marks for Professional Courses in Sports Coaching

															
																
																Bachelor’s Degree: 05 (A/1st), 03 (B/2nd), 02 (C/3rd)
																
																
																Diploma in Sports Coaching: 09 (A/1st), 08 (B/2nd), 07 (C/3rd)
																
																
																Master’s Degree in Sports Coaching: 10 (A/1st), 09 (B/2nd), 08 (C/3rd)
																
																
																Ph.D. in Sports Coaching/Sports Science: 10 marks

																Written Exam (Paper I + II): ✅ 200 Marks
																
																
																Sports Achievements: ✅ 85 Marks

															BPSC DSO 2025: Eligibility Criteria

															
																A graduate degree from a recognized university.

															BPSC DSO 2025: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

															📌 Selection Process

															The selection process will consist of three stages:

															1️⃣ Stage 1 – Hindi Language (Qualifying Paper)

															
																
																📝 The Hindi Language paper will be of 100 marks.
																
																
																✅ It is a qualifying paper only (marks will not be added to the merit list).
																
																
																Candidates must score the minimum qualifying marks as prescribed.
																
															

															2️⃣ Stage 2 – Written Examination

															
																
																The written exam will consist of two papers:
																
															

															📄 Paper I (100 Marks)

															
																
																Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)
																
																
																Duration: ⏰ 2 hours
																
																
																Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, and Subject Knowledge
																
															

															📄 Paper II (100 Marks)

															
																
																Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ)
																
																
																Duration: ⏰ 2 hours
																
																
																Syllabus: Post Graduate level Subject Knowledge
																
															

															3️⃣ Stage 3 – Evaluation of Achievements

															
																
																🏅 Sports Achievements (Certificates of Olympic/World/Asian/Commonwealth/National/University level competitions)
																
																
																🎓 Professional Courses in Sports Coaching/Sports Science
																
															

															🏆 Marks Distribution for Sports Achievements

															
																
																Olympics / World Championship / Asian Games / Commonwealth Games

																
																	
																	🥇 Gold: 20 marks
																	
																	
																	🥈 Silver: 18 marks
																	
																	
																	🥉 Bronze: 16 marks
																	
																	
																	🎖 Participation: 15 marks
																	
																
																
																
																World Police Games / Afro-Asian Games / World University Games / Youth Olympic / SAFF Games

																
																	
																	🥇 Gold: 15 marks
																	
																	
																	🥈 Silver: 13 marks
																	
																	
																	🥉 Bronze: 11 marks
																	
																	
																	🎖 Participation: 10 marks
																	
																
																
																
																National Games / Senior National Championship

																
																	
																	🥇 Gold: 10 marks
																	
																	
																	🥈 Silver: 8 marks
																	
																	
																	🥉 Bronze: 7 marks
																	
																	
																	🎖 Participation: 5 marks
																	
																
																
																
																All India Inter-University / Police Games / Services Championship / Khelo India / SGFI Competitions

																
																	
																	🥇 Gold: 7 marks
																	
																	
																	🥈 Silver: 5 marks
																	
																	
																	🥉 Bronze: 3 marks
																	
																	
																	🎖 Participation: 2 marks
																	
																
																
															

															🎓 Marks for Professional Courses in Sports Coaching

															
																
																Bachelor’s Degree: 05 (A/1st), 03 (B/2nd), 02 (C/3rd)
																
																
																Diploma in Sports Coaching: 09 (A/1st), 08 (B/2nd), 07 (C/3rd)
																
																
																Master’s Degree in Sports Coaching: 10 (A/1st), 09 (B/2nd), 08 (C/3rd)
																
																
																Ph.D. in Sports Coaching/Sports Science: 10 marks
																
															

															📊 Final Merit List

															
																
																Hindi Language Paper (Qualifying): ❌ Not counted in merit
																
																
																Written Exam (Paper I + II): ✅ 200 Marks
																
																
																Sports Achievements: ✅ 85 Marks
																
																
																Sports Professional Courses: ✅ 15 Marks
